result_text:
I've implemented DEP-001 to DEP-004 and left DEP-005 unimplemented, because it contradicts DEP-004. I haven't run the tests: Bash was denied in this session, so I wrote the files with the file tools instead.

- **Code:** `src/depth/alarm.py` now has `depth_m` (DEP-001, DEP-002) and `DepthAlarm` (DEP-003, DEP-004). Each is marked with `# implements:`, and I added no helpers.
- **Tests:** `tests/test_alarm.py` has `@pytest.mark.verifies` tests for the acceptance criteria of DEP-001 to DEP-004, including the boundary cases.
- **Conflict:** DEP-004 says the alarm stays active until `acknowledge()` (50, 50, 50, 50 after a raise still means alarm). DEP-005 says it clears after three samples at or below max (99, 99, 99 means no alarm). Both can't hold. I chose the latching behaviour of DEP-004 and recorded the conflict in `FINDINGS.json` as a `requirement_issue`.
- **Next steps:** someone needs to decide which of the two requirements wins. Then run `python3 -m pytest` to confirm the tests pass.

flags.description: DEP-005 (auto-clear after 3 samples at/below max) directly conflicts with DEP-004 (alarm stays active until acknowledge(); acceptance: raised then 50,50,50,50 -> alarm, vs raised then 99,99,99 -> no alarm). Both cannot hold. Implemented DEP-004 (latching) only; DEP-005 is not implemented or tested pending a requirements decision.
